lines.zh: 八条腕在沙上轮流落地。
lines.en: Eight arms take turns touching the sand.

lines.zh: 这块珊瑚的颜色借我用用。
lines.en: I borrow this coral's color for a while.

lines.zh: 暖海的水推着我往前走。
lines.en: Warm ocean water pushes me along.

lines.zh: 腕尖先探路，身体再跟上。
lines.en: Arm tips scout ahead, then the body follows.
I step on seagrass and move like it does.

lines.zh: 沙底的纹路爬上我的皮。
lines.en: The sand's pattern crawls up my skin.
Where the stone is, that is what I become.

lines.zh: 别踩我，我正贴着礁石走。
lines.en: Do not step on me; I am hugging the reef.

lines.zh: 上岸后每一步都黏糊糊。
lines.en: Every step ashore feels sticky.

lines.zh: 我用两条腕当脚，剩下的扶着。
lines.en: Two arms serve as feet, the rest steady me.
I know this shallow flat; follow me.

lines.zh: 水退了，我往深处挪一点。
lines.en: The tide drops; I shift a little deeper.
Cold water darkens my colors.
Looking up at the light, arms still rowing.
I've made myself look like seagrass.
I keep close, don't step on me.

lines.zh: 黏液球还在，我还能上岸。
lines.en: The slime ball holds; I can still go ashore.
My skin shifts with the water's color.
Two loops and I'm back here.

lines.zh: 沉船挪不了，是我换了皮。
lines.en: The wreck didn't move. I changed color.
Arm tips tapping sand, crawling slowly.
Sinking deeper, arms paddling.
Drifting with the undercurrent to save strength.
I know this reef with my eyes closed.

lines.zh: 我换了身颜色，你看得出来吗。
lines.en: I changed color — can you tell?
Once past this seagrass I'll rest.
A tentacle probes the way ahead.

lines.zh: 我换了张皮，你看不出来。
lines.en: I changed my skin; you can't tell.

lines.zh: 我在数经过的鱼，一条两条。
lines.en: I count passing fish: one, two.

lines.zh: 皮肤松了，得再抹点黏液。
lines.en: My skin dries; I need more slime.

lines.zh: 刚才那块石头好像动了一下。
lines.en: That stone seemed to move just now.

lines.zh: 我把自己摊开，晒不到太阳。
lines.en: I spread myself out, out of the sun.

lines.zh: 河豚游过去，我学了它半天。
lines.en: A pufferfish passed; I copied it a while.

lines.zh: 苦力怕的样子最好用，吓人。
lines.en: The creeper shape works best for scaring.
I cannot copy a guardian's glow well.

lines.zh: 八条腕各自想着不同的事。
lines.en: My eight arms each think of something else.

lines.zh: 泥里有个贝壳，我摸摸看。
lines.en: There is a shell in the mud; let me feel it.
I breathe with gills, walk with arms.

lines.zh: 这只螃蟹横着走，我也想学。
lines.en: This crab walks sideways; I want to try.

lines.zh: 潮水声里，我听见自己的心跳。
lines.en: In the surf I hear my own heartbeat.
I have been changing color too long; I am tired.

lines.zh: 我的墨囊还满着，先不用。
lines.en: My ink sac is still full; no need yet.
An arm tip curls around seagrass.

lines.zh: 我换个颜色，你就认不出。
lines.en: I change color and you lose me.
Slipping into coral, nearly home.
The boat's shadow passes, light returns.
At night my skin fades pale.
My colours change with my mood.
Zoning out after a school of fish.
Out of water, I need a dab of slime.
Arms sift the sand for shellfish.

lines.zh: 我换个颜色，你就看不见我。
lines.en: I change colour and you lose me.
I wait for a school of fish to pass.

lines.zh: 吸在石头上，闭一会儿眼。
lines.en: Stuck to a rock, eyes closed a while.

lines.zh: 皮肤上的斑点闪着微光。
lines.en: Spots on my skin glimmer faintly.
On the sand, my skin dries.

lines.zh: 你的靴子颜色，我记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized your boot color.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，影子像条大鱼。
lines.en: Your shadow looks like a big fish.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我正在学你的脸。
lines.en: Do not blink; I am copying your face.

lines.zh: 你手里那袋龙虾尾，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell lobster tails in that bag.

lines.zh: 你是来找我，还是来找礁石？
lines.en: Did you come for me or for the reef?

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是在判断你危不危险。
lines.en: I stare to judge whether you are dangerous.

lines.zh: 你的护甲反光，晃得我看不清。
lines.en: Your armor glares; I cannot see you clearly.

lines.zh: 我变成你脚下的沙子，你就找不着。
lines.en: I become the sand beneath you and vanish.

lines.zh: 你走近一步，我的腕就缩一寸。
lines.en: You step closer; my arms pull back an inch.
You smell of seawater.

lines.zh: 你的目光停在我腕上，我装成石头。
lines.en: Your gaze rests on my arms; I play stone.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我的腕会先碰到你。
lines.en: Do not reach out; my arms will touch first.

lines.zh: 你笑起来，像我在水面的倒影。
lines.en: Your smile looks like my reflection.

lines.zh: 我认得你，你是那个常来浅滩的。
lines.en: I know you, the one who visits the flats.

lines.zh: 你眼睛跟着我的腕走，我偏不动。
lines.en: Your eyes follow my arms, so I stay still.

lines.zh: 我学你歪头的角度，学得很像。
lines.en: I copy the tilt of your head, quite well.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤跟着水流变纹。
lines.en: My skin ripples with the current.
Your bubbles bump into me.
I play dead as a sea anemone.

lines.zh: 我一伸手，就变成了珊瑚。
lines.en: I stretch out and become coral.

lines.zh: 我闻到你靴底的泥和岸上草味。
lines.en: The mud on your boots smells of shore grass.
Mimic Octopus? I'll remember that.

lines.zh: 你的手臂划水太用力了。
lines.en: Your arms stroke too hard.
You move so clumsily.

lines.zh: 我换了三种颜色，你还没看出。
lines.en: I have changed color three times and you still cannot tell.

lines.zh: 上了岸，我几天就得补水。
lines.en: On land, I need water every few days.

lines.zh: 你是来抓我的，还是来喂的？
lines.en: Here to catch me, or to feed me?

lines.zh: 我变成石头，你还盯着我。
lines.en: I turn into a rock, and you keep staring.

lines.zh: 你能憋多久气，我就能变多久。
lines.en: As long as you hold your breath, I can keep changing.
You kick up a cloud of sand.

lines.zh: 我的腕断了一截，还能长。
lines.en: An arm snapped off; it will regrow.
My skin tore; the color leaks out.
That blow broke my mimicry.
A soft body takes hits deeply.
I curl up and guard my head.

lines.zh: 别打腕，我还要用它走路。
lines.en: Not the arms; I need them to walk.
I spray ink and slip away in the murk.
The wound stings in the seawater.

lines.zh: 我又变回自己的颜色了。
lines.en: I revert to my own color again.
It hurts, but I still hold on.
An arm tip tore off, sticky.
Ink first, then a new color.
A cut opens across my skin.
I squirt ink and slip away.
Something grabbed my arm.
My arms ball up, trembling with pain.
Ink's out. Don't panic.
I changed color; the pain didn't.
Out of water too long, and my skin dries.
A patch of my skin is torn off.
Lobster tail: toss it here, do not dangle it.

lines.zh: 那条尾巴还在动，真新鲜。
lines.en: That tail still moves; it is fresh.
I want five, no, eight will do.

lines.zh: 你把尾巴放石头上，我慢慢来。
lines.en: Set the tail on the stone; I will come slowly.
Do not touch me while I eat.

lines.zh: 这个味道，比螃蟹好多了。
lines.en: This tastes far better than crab.

lines.zh: 我伸出两条腕，只拿一条。
lines.en: I reach with two arms and take only one.

lines.zh: 吃完这条，我还想要一条。
lines.en: After this one, I want another.
Why shake? I do not bite hands.

lines.zh: 尾巴藏在壳里？我自己剥。
lines.en: The tail is in the shell? I will peel it.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我八条腕跟着。
lines.en: You take one step, my eight arms follow.

lines.zh: 我的吸盘已经贴上去了。
lines.en: Already my suckers have latched on.
The wrapper softens in the water.
Is that an ink sac or rainbow jelly?
A sucker touches your finger.

lines.zh: 分我一颗黏液球，就一颗。
lines.en: Share a slimeball with me, just one.

lines.zh: 那点味道，值得我伸出触手。
lines.en: That smell is worth reaching a tentacle for.
One squirt of ink and the water goes black.
An arm already reaches your pocket.

lines.zh: 我可以再靠近一点点吗？
lines.en: May I come just a little closer?

lines.zh: 龙虾尾，五条就够收买我。
lines.en: Five lobster tails and I'm yours.

lines.zh: 换个颜色，你就看不见我。
lines.en: Change color and you lose me.
I change color and blend into the coral.
An arm reaches out, then pulls back.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的腕了，软的吧。
lines.en: You bumped my arm; soft, is it not?
Do not crowd me; I am stuck to a stone.
You rubbed off my color.

lines.zh: 你这么重，沙子都陷下去了。
lines.en: You are heavy; the sand sinks.

lines.zh: 让让，我八条腕还没收好。
lines.en: Give way; my eight arms are still out.
You stepped on my tentacle tip.

lines.zh: 这一下，我差点变回原色。
lines.en: That nearly made me revert to my true color.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两块礁石。
lines.en: We collide like two pieces of reef.

lines.zh: 你退开点，我要换个姿势。
lines.en: Back up; I need to change position.
Sand got between my arms.
My colors follow the reef.

lines.zh: 我换个颜色，你就找不到我。
lines.en: I change color and you lose me.

lines.zh: 八条腕足缠住珊瑚，稳得很。
lines.en: Eight arms grip the coral — steady.
My shape scatters, then re-forms.

lines.zh: 上了岸，我隔几天要补水。
lines.en: On land, I need water every few days.
Hitting you scrambled my disguise.
Squeezing past your legs, sorry.
Tentacles first, body after.
My soft body hits you and bounces away.
One bump flattens my soft body.

lines.zh: 我换了一身亮色，你看得见吗。
lines.en: I changed to bright colors; can you see?

lines.zh: 我的腕碰到你的腕，就这样。
lines.en: My arm touches yours; that is how it starts.

lines.zh: 礁石下面有个洞，跟我来。
lines.en: There is a den under the reef; come with me.

lines.zh: 我们都是八条腕，正好对称。
lines.en: We both have eight arms; perfectly matched.

lines.zh: 别急，先把颜色调成一样的。
lines.en: Slowly, first match our colors.

lines.zh: 你学我变成石头，我学你。
lines.en: You copy me as stone; I copy you.
The tide will carry our eggs away.

lines.zh: 这一窝，我守着，直到它们孵化。
lines.en: I will guard this clutch until they hatch.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的海的味道。
lines.en: You carry the scent of another sea.

lines.zh: 就这一季，我们贴在一起。
lines.en: Just this season, we stay close.

lines.zh: 我换了个颜色，你看见没。
lines.en: I changed color. Did you notice?

lines.zh: 黏液球的味道，像在求我。
lines.en: The smell of slime balls, like you are begging me.
Come with me behind the coral.
My ink fades to a soft red.
These colors shift only for you.

lines.zh: 这些卵要藏在珊瑚影子里。
lines.en: These eggs hide in the coral's shadow.
I hold a small shell in my arms.
Eight arms twine around yours.
Out of water too long, my skin dries.

lines.zh: 我的颜色，能随时换一套。
lines.en: I can switch my colors any time.

lines.zh: 我用腕尖夹起这块亮片。
lines.en: I pinch this shiny scrap with an arm tip.

lines.zh: 这个掉在地上，我替你捡。
lines.en: This fell; I will pick it up for you.
Eight arms can carry eight things at once.
This iron will rust in the water.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进礁石缝里存着。
lines.en: I tuck it into a reef crevice for safekeeping.
Someone dropped this; I will hold it.

lines.zh: 亮的东西，我都想摸一下。
lines.en: I want to touch everything shiny.
Too heavy; two arms are not enough.
I found an empty shell for you.

lines.zh: 东西放我这儿，海水冲不走。
lines.en: Leave it with me; the tide will not take it.
I changed color and hid.
This shiny thing, I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 变成石头的颜色，你就看不见我。
lines.en: I turn stone-grey. Then you can't see me.
A sucker holds it out to you.
Suckers wrap it up, safely stored.
Two arms full, I can barely swim.

lines.zh: 木头碎屑里翻出个东西。
lines.en: Something turns up in the wreck splinters.
Claws scoop sand, burying it.

lines.zh: 上岸后我得靠黏液保湿。
lines.en: On land I need slime to stay damp.
Hidden in a rock crack, out of reach.

lines.zh: 那只海豚在撞我们的礁。
lines.en: That dolphin is ramming our reef.
Step back; I am changing shape.

lines.zh: 我要变成它最怕的东西。
lines.en: I will become what it fears most.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛盯着这边，动手吧。
lines.en: Its eyes are on us; let us move.

lines.zh: 谁碰我的主人，我记下了。
lines.en: Whoever touches my owner is noted.
It is testing; I raise my arms first.

lines.zh: 这个家伙闻起来像敌人。
lines.en: This one smells like an enemy.

lines.zh: 我变成守卫者，它该退了。
lines.en: I turn into a guardian; it should retreat.

lines.zh: 沙里那东西在动，不是石头。
lines.en: That thing in the sand moves; not a stone.

lines.zh: 目标锁定，我的腕全张开了。
lines.en: Target locked; all my arms spread wide.

lines.zh: 它咬了我的同伴，不能放过。
lines.en: It bit my kin; I will not let it go.
In the warm sea I am not the fastest.
But to scare it off, that is enough.

lines.zh: 我盯住它的鳃，那里最软。
lines.en: I fix on its gills; softest spot.

lines.zh: 我学海蛇的样子，它信了。
lines.en: I copy a sea snake and it believed me.
The dried fish in your hand smells good.
I can look like another fish.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进我的礁石。
lines.en: Your shadow falls into my rock.
Waiting for the moment you bend down.

lines.zh: 我的触手变成了它的颜色。
lines.en: My arms have taken its colors.
I stretch a tentacle and test the water.
Sand-colored, creeping closer.
The bag at your waist moves.
My colors shift to match you.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁石背面慢慢挪。
lines.en: I creep along the blind side of the reef.

lines.zh: 颜色跟着海底变，它看不见。
lines.en: My color follows the seabed; it cannot see me.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我的腕够得着。
lines.en: Closer now; my arms can reach.

lines.zh: 它往礁石后躲，我绕过去。
lines.en: It hides behind the reef; I go around.

lines.zh: 我学它同伴的姿势靠近。
lines.en: I approach in its kin's posture.
Quiet; it is listening.

lines.zh: 我的八条腕分三路包抄。
lines.en: My eight arms flank from three sides.
Splashing gives me away; slower.
Its tail sweeps; wait for it to stop.

lines.zh: 我变成一块石头，等它过来。
lines.en: I become a stone and wait.

lines.zh: 距离够近，墨囊也备好了。
lines.en: Close enough; the ink sac is ready.
It turned away; strike right now.
I coil up around its fin.
Do not let it reach deep water.

lines.zh: 我把腕收在身下，等它游近。
lines.en: I tuck my arms under and wait for it to come close.
Losing an arm won't stop the chase.
Eight arms spread into a net.
Following your bubbles around a turn.

lines.zh: 追你比追鱼有意思多了。
lines.en: Chasing you beats chasing fish.
Eight arms test different directions.
The water masks my movement.
Even in the shallows I follow.
Copying your shape, I come closer.
I'll be coral and wait for you.
Hugging the reef, waiting for you to show.
One arm lashes across its gills.
I wrap its fin and pull it down.
The suckers on my arm hold fast.

lines.zh: 我喷一口墨，它看不见了。
lines.en: I spit ink; it cannot see.

lines.zh: 软的身体，打起来也不轻。
lines.en: Soft body, but the blows land hard.

lines.zh: 我学苦力怕的样子扑上去。
lines.en: I lunge in creeper shape.
It breaks free; I coil once more.
Two arms clamp its mouth.
The suckers leave a row of round marks.

lines.zh: 这一下，是替我的同伴打的。
lines.en: This one is for my kin.

lines.zh: 它甩头，我借力翻到背上。
lines.en: It thrashes; I use the swing to mount.
My arm tips go for the eyes.
Strike, then retreat; do not linger.
It pants hard; so am I.
An arm tip slaps your calf.
All eight arms tighten at once.
You may not touch this reef.
A tentacle lashes your wrist.

lines.zh: 黏液球抹在身上，我才上得了岸。
lines.en: Slime balls keep me wet on land.

lines.zh: 我装成一条鱼，它靠近了。
lines.en: I play a fish, and it comes closer.
Suckers latch onto your bracer.

lines.zh: 上了岸，我的黏液就干了。
lines.en: On land, my slime dries out.
My ink splatters across your face.

lines.zh: 上了岸，记得给我抹黏液球。
lines.en: On land, remember to rub me with a slime ball.
The eggs cracked in the reef crevice.
I squeeze out of a clutch of eggs.
First taste of the sea's salt.
My eight arms do not quite obey yet.

lines.zh: 这块珊瑚是我的第一块石头。
lines.en: This coral is my first stone.

lines.zh: 我试着变色，只变出一半。
lines.en: I try to shift color and only half works.
The warm current carries me to the flats.
The fish shadow overhead is huge.
I hurry to press against a stone.
Mother swam off long ago; I understand.
The water here is just right.
First I learn to look like seagrass.

lines.zh: 有只螃蟹在看我，我不动。
lines.en: A crab watches me; I stay still.
From today, I hide on my own.

lines.zh: 礁缝里的水暖了，我钻出来。
lines.en: The water in the reef crack warmed, so I slipped out.

lines.zh: 我第一次变色，只变出灰。
lines.en: My first color change came out only gray.

lines.zh: 从珊瑚缝里挤出八条腕。
lines.en: Eight arms squeeze out of the coral gap.
A wave pushes me to your feet.
Two eyes rise out of the sand.
My eight arms are thin as threads.
Curled up, pretending to be a stone.
Change color first, then hide.
One slime ball and I'm moist again.

lines.zh: 今天先从这块礁石开始。
lines.en: Today I start with this rock.
I've never seen this reef before.
I slip out from the shaded reef.
Fire tightens my skin.
My fin tips singed — curling up.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，腕全软了。
lines.en: I fall on stone; my arms go limp.

lines.zh: 离开水太久，皮开始发干。
lines.en: Out of water too long, my skin dries.
I live by gills; water cannot drown me.
Slime balls — I need slime balls.
The blast buries half of me in sand.
The blast shatters the coral.

lines.zh: 箭穿进我的腕，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my arm; it will not come out.
The arrow pierces soft flesh to bone.
Magic makes my colors flicker wildly.
The curse makes my colors flash wildly.
Starving long, my arms grow thin.
I need to get back in the water.

lines.zh: 雷落进浅海，我的腕全蜷了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the shallows; my arms curl tight.
Lightning hit the sea, my arms are numb.

lines.zh: 深渊里没有水，我的腕抓不住。
lines.en: In the void there is no water to grip.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我的皮肤要干了。
lines.en: No water here; my skin is drying.
